Motion guard rail

Everything on this page moves. Both origins serve it identically, so a score below parity means motion survived into the screenshot.

This paragraph pulses between full and near-zero opacity.

Notes

A spinner at one and a tenth seconds per revolution is at an effectively arbitrary angle whenever the shot lands. Two captures taken seconds apart would disagree on almost every pixel inside the circle, which makes this the cheapest possible check that motion is actually being frozen rather than merely slowed.

The caret matters for the same reason and is easy to forget: a text cursor blinks on a timer of its own, independent of any CSS animation on the page.
